products.product_description: REEF NET brand Wild Pacific Smoked Salmon. Product is Ready-To-Eat, hot smoked, vacuum packaged in 1 lb.; 1.5 lbs.; and 2 lbs. package, keep refrigerated or keep frozen. The label is read in parts: "***REEF NET Brand *** Wild Pacific Smoked Salmon***Ingredients: Fish, salt, brown sugar, natural wood smoke***Important: Keep frozen until used. Thaw under refrigeration immediately before uses***BARLEAN'S FISHERY***3660 Slater Road, Ferndale, WA 98248***".
products.code_info: CM1517, CM1617, CM1717, CM1817, CM1917, CM2017, CO2117, CM2217, CM2317, and CM2417. The codes are interpreted as: CM = Chum Salmon CO = Coho Salmon first and second digit = sequential batch number of the year. third and fourth digit = calendar year 2017.
products.reason_for_recall: REEF NET brand Wild Pacific Smoked Salmon, Ready-To-Eat product, is recalled due to undeclared soy lecithin. The firm used soy release agent but did not declare soy lecithin in the ingredients statement. There was no allergens "Contains" statement on affected product's label.
